title: Ansible on a Small Network
intro: **What earns a milestone.** Each lab milestone fires when the student's `dojo netlab check A<n>` passes (exit 0): the checker confirms the pod's end state from outside, on both branches, and that the manual and automated branches agree. The A labs are the playbook labs; the M labs they repeat by hand have no check. Labs A10 and A11 are stretch and not `core`.
